company_description: Arkema is a French chemical company specializing in high-performance polymers, adhesives, and innovative materials for batteries, packaging, and industrial applications.

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenue of the consolidated group, reflecting overall commercial performance.

kpis.name: EBITDA
kpis.explanation: Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization, a key indicator of operational profitability.

kpis.name: EBITDA Margin
kpis.explanation: EBITDA to revenue ratio, measuring the group's operational efficiency.

kpis.name: Net Income - Group Share
kpis.explanation: Net profit attributable to group shareholders after taxes and interest.

kpis.name: Operating Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash generated from operating activities, an indicator of earnings quality.

kpis.name: Free Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash available after investments, measuring capacity for shareholder distributions.

kpis.name: Net Debt
kpis.explanation: Net financial debt after cash deduction, an indicator of financial leverage.

kpis.name: Adjusted Net Income per Share
kpis.explanation: Adjusted earnings per share, excluding non-recurring items for comparability.

kpis.name: PVDF Capacity Expansion Kentucky
kpis.description: Arkema is investing $20 million to increase its PVDF production capacity by 15% in Calvert City (Kentucky), with start-up expected mid-2026, supporting growing demand for high-performance resins in lithium-ion batteries and semiconductors.

kpis.name: Biomass Agreement with ENGIE
kpis.description: Arkema signs a 25 GWh/year biomass contract with ENGIE covering 85% of the annual gas consumption of four Bostik sites in France, accelerating the decarbonization of its energy supply chain.

kpis.name: Climate 'A' Rating (CDP)
kpis.description: Arkema achieves an 'A' rating in CDP Climate Change (vs A- in 2023), placing it in the top 2% of 24,700 companies assessed, validating its commitment to environmental transparency and sustainable development performance.

kpis.name: Acquisition of Dow Adhesives Business
kpis.description: Arkema acquires Dow's flexible packaging adhesives business for $150 million (generating $250 million in annual revenue), positioning the group as a key player in the attractive flexible packaging solutions market.

kpis.name: Pebax Capacity Expansion Serquigny
kpis.description: Arkema finalizes an investment in Serquigny (France) increasing Pebax® elastomer production capacity by 40% and reducing water consumption by 25%, supporting growth in sports and consumer goods.

kpis.name: Investment in Tiamat
kpis.description: Arkema acquires a stake in Tiamat, a pioneer in sodium-ion battery technology, accelerating the development of technical solutions tailored to next-generation batteries.

kpis.name: Start-up of PA11 Singapore and HF USA Plants
kpis.description: The PA11 plant in Singapore and the Nutrien HF plant in the United States are now operational and ramping up in the second half of 2024, strengthening the group's geographic footprint.

risks.description: Significant decline in revenue (-5% in 2025) and EBITDA (-18.3%), reflecting a contraction in industrial and chemical demand. EBITDA margin contracts to 13.8% vs 16.1% in 2024, indicating pricing pressure and underutilization of capacity.
risks.score_rationale: Position: major deterioration of key KPIs in H1 2025. Intensity: double-digit EBITDA decline. Trend: continuation of weakness since 2022 (peak at 11.55 Bn €). Weight: direct impact on profitability and cash flow.

risks.description: High net debt at €3.17 Bn with a deteriorated net debt/EBITDA ratio (2.5x vs 2.1x in 2024), limiting financial flexibility amid operational contraction and announced growth investments.
risks.score_rationale: Position: stable but high net debt in a context of reduced profitability. Intensity: leverage ratio deterioration. Trend: increasing debt since 2020 (€1.91 Bn). Weight: constraint on dividends and M&A.

risks.description: Exposure to volatility in raw material prices and foreign exchange rates (consolidation in USD and other currencies), impacting margins and price competitiveness against Asian peers.
risks.score_rationale: Position: international group with significant FX exposure. Intensity: EBITDA margin sensitive to pricing. Trend: persistent volatility in chemical markets. Weight: direct impact on profitability.

risks.description: Energy transition and increasing environmental regulations (CSRD, EU Taxonomy) requiring investments in decarbonization and traceability, with risk of non-recoverable cost increases.
risks.score_rationale: Position: strong commitment (CDP 'A' rating) but implementation costs. Intensity: moderate language on regulatory risks. Trend: gradual tightening of standards. Weight: medium-term impact on capex.
